description:
This 3 bedroom end-terrace residence is an ideal family home situated in Grange Rath, Drogheda, Co. Meath. The well planned and spacious interiors are flooded with natural light and extend to c. 105 sq. m (1,130 sq. ft). The living room and kitchen/dining areas are of generous proportions and good dimensions. Briefly, this is a quality home in a prime family location within easy access of schools, shopping, the M1 Motorway and bus routes into both Drogheda and Dublin city centre. Located within a stroll of South Gate Shopping Centre (Dunnes Stores, Butchers, Newsagents, etc.), Grange Rath is located just off the Dublin Road where you can find Drogheda Train Station.
